title: Jury Learning: Integrating Dissenting Voices into Machine Learning Models

bias_targets.methodology: Evaluating predictive performance (Mean Absolute Error) of the model for individual annotators across different racial groups (Asian, Black, Hispanic, White), and comparing racial representation diversity in baseline implicit juries versus practitioner-defined classification juries.

Evaluating model prediction accuracy (MAE) of individual annotator responses across different gender identities (Male, Female, Non-binary), and analyzing the proportional representation of various genders in user-constructed classification juries.

Measuring the model's predictive error (MAE) for annotator labels across different political affiliations (Liberal, Independent, Conservative), and assessing political diversity and representation in custom jury compositions.

Evaluating predictive performance (MAE) of the model on the individual labels of annotators belonging to specific intersectional identity groups (e.g., Asian+Female+Liberal, Hispanic+Male+Conservative).
